title: W. Kimball DeLaMare, LCSW
excerpt: Editorial research draft about Kimball DeLaMare, director of KIDS of Greater Salt Lake in 1989, co-founder of Island View and the Oakley School, and NATSAP's founding president. The 1989 lawsuit and police referral outcomes are not yet known.

meta.person_role: Founding president of NATSAP; co-founder of Island View RTC and the Oakley School; director of KIDS of Greater Salt Lake (1989)

person_notable_work: Directed a Utah branch of Miller Newton's Straight spin-off KIDS
First NATSAP president; helped write its Ethical Principles
Helped craft licensing policy in several states, by his own account
